adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) is nil it unconditionally enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) and renders embed/loading. The loading view (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb) auto-reloads every 30s. If retrieval cannot ever create an embed (e.g., TopicRetriever invalid_host? returns true because params[:embed_url] host differs from SiteSetting.embeddable_host, or TopicRetriever#fetch_http can error when SiteSetting.embed_by_username is nil due to .downcase), then topic_id will remain nil and the iframe will keep re-requesting /embed/best, repeatedly enqueuing RetrieveTopic jobs indefinitely.
